reason: I run a 100-500 person shop and a tool that reads our POs and supplier emails and ranks what will hit our work orders sounds useful, but I have heard this pitch before and a wrong date is what costs us a shortage on the floor. I would take the free six-week test with exports and a few forwarded emails, and I would not sign a monthly paid pilot until my buyers say the ranked list is right.
objection: If it misreads one supplier acknowledgement or misses a backorder, my buyers stop trusting the morning list and we are back to chasing suppliers by hand, with one more tool to explain to my plant manager.
would_change_my_mind: Proof on our own data during the free test: it catches real late and short shipments that my buyers had not yet seen, with few false alarms, and my team says it saves them time in the daily shortage meeting.
